description: Fix all confirmed security issues in the frontend and verify the full stack runs. Path traversal and temp-file leak in frontend/routes/util.js POST /selection-export; wide-open CORS in frontend/index.js; nginx autoindex in frontend/web/nginx.conf; hardcoded Express port. Also verify Express 5 compatibility of the routes (res.sendFile, express.static, router behavior) now that FEAT-001 upgraded express to v5. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the upgraded express/cors/fluent-ffmpeg deps in place).
steps: Read /home/hoogden/Desktop/GIT/audiostreamlogger/.worktrees/security-update/.agents/tasks/context.json and this file FIRST. Note: the frontend container runs Express only (nginx.conf is not used at runtime); the client calls same-origin /api, so locking down CORS is safe.

frontend/index.js — CORS: replace `app.use(cors())` with conditional CORS from process.env.CORS_ORIGIN: if set, app.use(cors({ origin: CORS_ORIGIN.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()) })); if unset, register NO cross-origin middleware. Add a comment explaining the frontend is same-origin so cross-origin is disabled by default.

frontend/index.js — port: replace `const PORT = 80` with `const PORT = process.env.APP_PORT || 80` and add a comment noting that docker-compose maps host ${PORT} to container 80, so the in-container listen port must stay 80 by default (use APP_PORT only to override inside the container; do NOT consume the host-facing PORT env). Keep static/route wiring unchanged.

frontend/routes/util.js — validation: in POST /selection-export, validate station_id against /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/, year against /^\d{4}$/, month/day/hour against /^\d{2}$/; reject with 400 on any failure. Validate startTime and endTime are finite non-negative numbers with endTime > startTime, else 400.

frontend/routes/util.js — path containment: build the audio base dir (path.resolve(__dirname, '../audio')), construct the requested file path, path.resolve it, and confirm the resolved path starts with the resolved audio base dir + path.sep (reject with 400 if it escapes). Keep the existing 404 when the source file does not exist.

frontend/routes/util.js — temp file: write the ffmpeg output to os.tmpdir() (not the public audio dir) with a unique name (e.g. path.join(os.tmpdir(), `export-${Date.now()}-${process.pid}.mp3`)). Clean up the temp file in ALL paths: the ffmpeg 'error' handler and the res.sendFile callback (even when sendFile errors). Guard cleanup with fs.existsSync + try/catch so cleanup never throws. require('os') at the top.

frontend/web/nginx.conf — change `autoindex on;` to `autoindex off;` and add a comment that this file is not used by the current Express-only container (defense-in-depth for any future nginx deployment).

Verify Express 5 compatibility: confirm express.static, express.Router, res.json/status/send, and res.sendFile with an absolute path still behave under express v5 (res.sendFile with an absolute path is supported). Adjust only if the build or smoke test reveals a break.
Run the full build and runtime smoke test and fix any issues.
acceptance_criteria: A station_id of '../../etc' (or any value failing the whitelist) returns HTTP 400 and never reaches ffmpeg; a resolved path escaping the audio dir is rejected with 400.
The temp export file is created under os.tmpdir() and is removed on ffmpeg success, ffmpeg error, and sendFile error (no leak into the audio dir).
frontend/index.js registers CORS only when CORS_ORIGIN is set; with it unset no cross-origin headers are added. Express listens on 80 by default so the compose ${PORT}:80 mapping still works.
frontend/web/nginx.conf contains `autoindex off;` and no `autoindex on;`.
`docker compose build` succeeds and `docker compose up -d` brings up all four containers without crash-looping; frontend logs 'Server is running on port 80' and the others log their 'is OK!' lines.
verification: docker compose up -d && sleep 15 && docker compose ps && docker compose logs --tail=40 && docker compose down  (no container restarting; expected startup log lines present)
Reason through / check that station_id '../../etc' is rejected with 400 before any ffmpeg call
findings:
Done and verified.

frontend/routes/util.js (POST /selection-export): added strict whitelist validation BEFORE building any path or calling ffmpeg -- station_id /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/, year /^\d{4}$/, month/day/hour /^\d{2}$/ (each must be a string); returns 400 on any failure. startTime/endTime coerced with Number() and required to be finite, non-negative, with endTime > startTime (else 400). Path containment: audioBaseDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../audio'); pathToFile = path.resolve(audioBaseDir, file); rejected with 400 unless pathToFile === audioBaseDir or startsWith(audioBaseDir + path.sep). Existing 404 for missing source file kept. Temp-file leak fixed: ffmpeg output now written to os.tmpdir() via path.join(os.tmpdir(), `export-${Date.now()}-${process.pid}.mp3`) instead of the public audio dir. Added require('os') and a cleanupTempFile() helper (fs.existsSync guard + try/catch so it never throws); cleanup is invoked on the res.sendFile callback (including when sendFile errors) AND in the ffmpeg 'error' handler -- temp file removed on success, ffmpeg error, and send error alike.

frontend/index.js: CORS -- replaced app.use(cors()) with conditional registration: when process.env.CORS_ORIGIN is set, app.use(cors({ origin: CORS_ORIGIN.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()) })); when unset, NO cross-origin middleware is registered (safe same-origin default). Port -- const PORT = process.env.APP_PORT || 80, with a comment that compose maps host ${PORT} to container 80 so the in-container listen port stays 80 by default and APP_PORT is an in-container override only (does not consume the host-facing PORT env). Static/route wiring unchanged.

frontend/web/nginx.conf: autoindex on -> autoindex off, with a comment noting the file is not used by the Express-only container (defense-in-depth for any future nginx deployment).

Express 5 compatibility: re-confirmed online that res.sendFile with an absolute path is still supported in Express 5 (absolute path is exactly what the API requires; the temp path from os.tmpdir() is absolute). express.static, express.Router, and res.json/status/send are unchanged across the v4->v5 migration. No code changes were needed for compatibility; the live smoke test confirms routing works.

Verification: `docker compose build` -> all four images built (exit 0). Runtime smoke test run with a temporary host port override (PORT=19703) because the user's ORIGINAL parent stack (project 'audiostreamlogger') is still running and holds host port 9703 -- the task said not to disturb the running instance, so the worktree stack was tested on a free host port while the container still listened on 80. `docker compose up -d` + 15s: `docker compose ps` showed all four containers 'Up 15 seconds' with none restarting/crash-looping; frontend mapped 0.0.0.0:19703->80/tcp. Logs: frontend 'Server is running on port 80'; recorder 'Recorder is OK!...'; cleaner 'Cleaner is OK!...'; peakfilegenerator 'Peakfile generator is OK!...'. `docker compose down` cleaned up. Path-traversal: station_id '../../etc' contains '/' and '.', neither in [A-Za-z0-9_-], so the whitelist regex returns false and the handler responds 400 before building any path or invoking ffmpeg; the path.resolve containment check is a second layer. The ${PORT}:80 mapping keeps working because the container listen port defaults to 80.
